description: What the veil window may do while the screen is frozen: say that it painted, hand back the rectangle the user dragged, and cancel the capture. Nothing else. It is granted no `core:` permission on purpose - it had no capability at all before this file existed, so every core and plugin command was already refused to it (those carry a `plugin:` prefix and are gated whatever the application manifest says), and granting none here leaves the veil exactly as capable as it was. The three commands below stay guarded a second time in Rust by `ipc::ensure_from`. No `remote` block exists here either, and that absence is deliberate: it is what makes `!is_local` refuse any non-local origin outright.
